ValidationRule.description: Delete and recreate if a relationship should change to avoid issues with rollups
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISNEW()) && OR(ISCHANGED( Assignment__c ), ISCHANGED(Case__c) , ISCHANGED(Resource__c)) && NOT( $Permission.Edit_TImecards_Once_Billing_Starts )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the Assignment, Case or Resource value. If these need to change, delete the case time record and create a new one on the correct case, assignment and resource.
